title: Người Đàn Bà Thức Dậy Trước Mặt Trời
time_label: 04:00 Rạng sáng, phố cổ Hà Nội (00:00–01:00)
location: Mái ngói phố cổ Hà Nội lúc rạng sáng (clip 1), rồi gian bếp tầng trệt căn nhà ống ba tầng trong một ngõ nhỏ.
axis: Máy quay đặt phía bàn ăn nhìn vào bếp: nồi đồ xôi bên trái, cầu thang dốc bên phải, kệ có camera nhỏ trên cao phía sau.
props: Nồi đồ xôi nhôm lớn, lá chuối, bát xôi, bàn thờ nhỏ với ba nén hương, gậy tre của bà Nhàn, chiếc camera nhỏ màu trắng trên kệ bếp.
setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Mới bốn giờ sáng, cả phố còn ngủ say, con dâu tôi đã lục đục dưới bếp đồ xôi rồi.
clips.camera: 24mm aerial descending glide from the rooftops down to an upper-floor window
beats: High aerial view over the dark tiled roofs of the old quarter before dawn, thin mist drifting between rooftops and yellow streetlamps glowing in the narrow alleys below.

The camera glides down past tangled overhead wires to a small upper-floor window of a narrow tube house, where @BaNhan swings open the wooden shutters and murmurs to herself, her wrinkled face clear in the lamplight.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and gazes down at the warm light and soft steam spilling from the kitchen window below, one hand pressed to her lower back.
clips.sfx: a distant rooster, a cold breeze, wooden shutters creaking, a soft hiss of steam below
clips.setting: Pre-dawn aerial over the tiled roofs of Hà Nội's old quarter: mist, yellow streetlamps, a few lit kitchen windows.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Con lạy tổ tiên, mười hai năm làm dâu, con chỉ xin chồng con làm ăn suôn sẻ, cả nhà bình an.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow push-in toward the altar shelf
beats: The dim kitchen before dawn, a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer rattling on the gas stove beside a small family altar shelf glowing with a tiny red lamp.
@Thu steps in front of the altar shelf in her green apron, raises three lit incense sticks to her forehead and whispers a prayer, her lips moving softly in the red glow.
@Thu closes her mouth, plants the incense sticks in the small bowl on the shelf and turns toward the steamer as a thick cloud of steam rolls up.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, the steamer lid rattling, the gas flame purring, a faint crackle of incense

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Hồi anh ấy còn trắng tay, cả nhà sống nhờ mấy gói xôi này, tay có chai đi một chút cũng chẳng sao.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up framing her face and hands over the table, slow tilt
beats: @Thu bends over the wooden table with her face and work-roughened hands both in frame, scooping warm sticky rice onto a square of green banana leaf as she starts to murmur to herself.
@Thu keeps murmuring with a faint wry smile, her lips moving clearly while her fingers fold the banana-leaf corners into a neat parcel.
@Thu closes her mouth and sets the finished parcel beside a growing row of identical green parcels, her calloused fingertips resting on the last one.
clips.sfx: banana leaves rustling, a soft steam hiss, the gas flame purring

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Lưng đau quá không ngủ được, thôi xuống đỡ con Thu một tay, nó gánh cả cái nhà này rồi.
clips.camera: 40mm medium low-angle shot from the foot of the staircase, slow tilt up
beats: The steep tiled staircase in the dim light, a faint glow from the kitchen climbing the steps, the upper floor still dark.
@BaNhan comes slowly down the stairs in her brown cardigan, leaning on her bamboo walking stick, and mutters to herself with her wrinkled face turned toward the light.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and pauses on the lowest step with one hand pressed to her lower back, her eyes fixed on the warm kitchen.
clips.sfx: slow footsteps on tiles, the tap of a bamboo stick, steam hissing below

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Thu ơi, con nghỉ tay ăn miếng xôi đi đã, tối qua thằng Tùng lại về muộn hả con?
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder two-shot across the dining table, slow dolly
beats: The wooden dining table beside the stove, a plate of banana-leaf parcels and two low stools, steam drifting through the warm light.
@BaNhan lowers herself onto a stool by the table as @Thu turns from the stove, and @BaNhan speaks to her softly, her wrinkled face creased with concern.
@BaNhan finishes speaking and keeps her eyes on @Thu, both hands resting on top of her bamboo stick.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a stool creaking, a rooster outside

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh ấy dạo này nhiều việc lắm mẹ ạ, mẹ cứ lên ngủ thêm đi, con lo được hết.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up over the table, slow push-in
beats: @Thu sets a small bowl of warm sticky rice in front of @BaNhan, wiping her hands on her green apron.
@Thu speaks gently with a thin tired smile, her eyes sliding away toward the dark staircase.
@Thu turns back to the stove and lifts the steamer lid again, her shoulders tight under the faded blue blouse.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, chopsticks against a bowl, a distant moped

title: Đôi Bông Tai Đã Bán
location: Gánh xôi nhỏ của Thu dưới chiếc ô bạc màu ở một góc vỉa hè phố cổ lúc hửng sáng; clip 3 ở bếp nhà Thu (bà Nhàn nói với camera).
axis: Máy quay trên vỉa hè nhìn vào gánh xôi: nồi xôi bên trái Thu, lòng đường và xe máy phía sau bên phải.
props: Thúng tre, nồi xôi bốc khói, lá chuối, ghế nhựa thấp, hộp bông tai nhung đỏ rỗng, điện thoại cũ của Thu, chiếc camera nhỏ màu trắng trên kệ bếp.
setting: Dawn on a Hà Nội old-quarter pavement corner: a small sticky-rice stall with a bamboo basket, a steaming pot and banana leaves under a big faded umbrella, low plastic stools, mopeds passing, blue-grey dawn light and yellow streetlamps.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Cô ơi, sương lạnh thế này, cô ngồi làm gói xôi nóng đã, sáng nào cháu cũng phần cô một gói.
clips.camera: 24mm wide establishing shot, slow lateral track along the pavement
beats: A quiet old-quarter street corner at dawn, yellow streetlamps still glowing and mist over the pavement, a small sticky-rice stall steaming under a big faded umbrella.
@Thu lifts the lid of the steaming pot as an elderly woman street sweeper in an orange vest pauses by the stall with her bamboo broom, and @Thu calls to her warmly with a bright smile.
@Thu closes her mouth and holds out a warm banana-leaf parcel across the basket, and the sweeper leans her broom on the umbrella pole and takes it with both hands.
clips.sfx: a moped passing, steam hissing, a bamboo broom sweeping the pavement
clips.extras: an elderly woman street sweeper in an orange vest with a bamboo broom

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Đôi bông tai cưới, của hồi môn duy nhất, mười hai năm trước mình bán đi cho anh ấy làm vốn.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: Close on the stall's low plastic stool and the bamboo basket of banana leaves, steam drifting across the frame in the grey dawn.
@Thu sits on the low stool, opens a small empty red velvet earring box with her thumb and murmurs to herself, her lips moving softly as she gazes at the bare velvet.
@Thu closes her mouth and rests her thumb on the empty velvet slot, her eyes glistening in the grey dawn light.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, the soft click of a box lid, a moped far away

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Thu ơi, thằng Tùng nó làm giám đốc rồi, con còn ra gánh xôi làm gì cho khổ thân hả con?
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow push-in toward the high kitchen shelf
beats: Early morning light in the narrow kitchen, the small white home camera on the high kitchen shelf blinking its tiny light above the empty dining table and a covered plate of banana-leaf parcels.
@BaNhan shuffles into the kitchen on her bamboo walking stick, looks up at the small white home camera and speaks up to it with a fond crinkled smile.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and gives the camera a small wave, then lowers herself onto a stool beside the covered plate of parcels.
clips.sfx: a bamboo stick tapping on tiles, a stool creaking, a rooster outside
clips.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mẹ ơi, anh ấy giàu thì giàu, con vẫn phải giữ cái nghề, lỡ mai kia nhà mình lại trắng tay.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow rack focus
beats: The edge of the stall's low stool with an old cracked smartphone lying face-up beside the basket, its screen glowing blank in the dawn light.
@Thu picks up the old phone, looks at its glowing blank screen with a soft laugh, then holds it close to her mouth and speaks into it warmly.
@Thu closes her mouth with a small relieved smile and slips the phone back into her apron pocket as steam drifts past the umbrella.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a distant moped, soft dawn birdsong

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Xôi xéo hành phi nóng đây, chị ăn thử đi, em gói thêm cho chị ít ruốc nhé!
clips.camera: 35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the customer, gentle dolly
beats: The steaming pot under the faded umbrella, banana-leaf parcels lined up in the bamboo basket, a moped parked at the curb.
@Thu stands behind the pot facing a woman customer in a pink raincoat, holds up a warm banana-leaf parcel and speaks to her with a bright smile.
@Thu finishes speaking and tucks an extra spoonful of pork floss into the parcel, then hands it across the basket as the customer nods.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, rustling banana leaves, mopeds passing
clips.extras: a woman customer in a pink raincoat

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Chồng em làm ở tòa nhà kính đằng kia chị ạ, ngày xưa hai vợ chồng chỉ dám đứng dưới đường mà nhìn.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow crane up into a wide view
beats: @Thu wipes her hands on her green apron and nods toward the distant skyline, starting to speak to the customer in the pink raincoat with a shy proud smile.
@Thu keeps speaking with her face turned up toward the far glass towers, a wistful light in her eyes, as the camera begins to rise above the faded umbrella.
The camera keeps rising above the umbrella to reveal glass towers on the distant skyline catching the sunrise, while @Thu stands silent beside the tiny steaming stall below.
clips.sfx: mopeds, morning street noise rising, steam hissing
clips.extras: a woman customer in a pink raincoat

title: Ông Giám Đốc Mới Phất
location: Gian bếp kiêm phòng ăn tầng trệt căn nhà ống của Thu, buổi sáng.
axis: Cửa ra ngõ bên phải màn hình, cầu thang và gương treo bên trái, bàn ăn ở giữa.
props: Gương treo cạnh cầu thang, chiếc trống con màu đỏ của Na, bát xôi hành phi, cặp tài liệu da và điện thoại của Tùng.
setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Cậu đánh xe ra đầu ngõ đón tôi, lau cho bóng vào, hôm nay tôi ký hợp đồng lớn đấy.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in toward the mirror
beats: Morning light through the open front door of the narrow house, a small mirror hanging beside the steep tiled staircase, a leather briefcase on a stool.
@Tung steps in front of the mirror in his charcoal-grey suit with a sleek phone pressed to his ear, smoothing his gelled hair as he speaks into it in a clipped bossy tone.
@Tung closes his mouth, lowers the phone and fastens the gold watch on his wrist, studying his reflection with his chin raised.
clips.sfx: a moped outside, the click of a watch clasp, morning birds

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Lần này mình phải rủ được bố đi xem diễn, năm nào cũng chỉ có mẹ với bà đến thôi.
clips.camera: 50mm close-up at child height, slow dolly-in
beats: The foot of the steep staircase seen from child height, a small red toy drum with two wooden sticks resting on the bottom step in the morning light.
@Na comes down the last steps in her school uniform and red scarf, hugs the little red drum to her chest and whispers to herself, her bright eyes turned toward the mirror.
@Na closes her mouth and rises onto her toes at the bottom of the stairs, holding the drum tight, waiting with a hopeful face.
clips.sfx: light footsteps on tiles, a soft drum tap, a moped outside

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Bố ơi, chiều nay bố đến xem con đánh trống nhé, cô giáo bảo ai cũng có bố mẹ đến.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow dolly
beats: The space beside the mirror and the staircase, a leather briefcase on a stool, warm morning light falling across the tiled floor.
@Na steps up to @Tung holding the little red drum to her chest and speaks up at him, her pigtails bobbing.
@Na finishes and waits with her eyes fixed on @Tung's face, her small fingers tight around the drumsticks.
clips.sfx: a moped outside, morning birds

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Bố bận họp cả ngày, con bảo mẹ đi xem cho, bố còn phải kiếm tiền nuôi cả nhà.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up over the drum, slow push-in
beats: @Tung glances down at @Na and gives the top of her head one quick distracted pat, his other hand already lifting his briefcase.
@Tung speaks to @Na while checking the gold watch on his wrist, his eyes never quite meeting hers.
@Na lowers the little red drum slowly to her side, her lower lip tucked in as @Tung turns away toward the door.
clips.sfx: a briefcase clasp clicking, footsteps on tiles

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh ăn bát xôi rồi hẵng đi, em đồ từ sáng sớm, vẫn còn nóng nguyên đây này.
clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot from the kitchen, slow lateral dolly
beats: The kitchen near the open front door, a bowl of steaming sticky rice with fried shallots resting on the wooden dining table.
@Thu comes from the stove carrying the bowl of steaming sticky rice in both hands and speaks to @Tung as he reaches the doorway.
@Thu holds the bowl out toward @Tung across the gap between them, steam rising between her hands.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a moped idling outside

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Thôi, xôi với chả xôi, ngày nào cũng xôi, anh ra ngoài ăn cho sạch sẽ.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in on the bowl
beats: @Tung looks at the bowl with a curl of his lip, already half-turned toward the open front door.
@Tung speaks curtly over his shoulder and walks out into the bright alley without looking back, his briefcase swinging.
@Thu stands alone in the doorway holding the steaming bowl in both hands, the steam thinning in the cold morning air.
clips.sfx: footsteps leaving, a car door shutting outside, an engine pulling away

title: Cô Thư Ký Váy Đỏ
location: Phòng giám đốc tường kính trên tầng cao một tòa tháp giữa Hà Nội.
axis: Bàn làm việc trắng ở giữa, cửa kính nhìn ra thành phố phía sau; cửa ra vào bên trái màn hình.
props: Bàn trắng, khung ảnh gia đình Thu – Tùng – Na, hộp cơm sơn mài đen bóng, mô hình tòa nhà, túi giấy mua mang về.
setting: A modern glass-walled director's office high in a Hà Nội tower: a large white desk with a family photo frame, a black leather chair, an architectural model of a residential tower, the city skyline beyond the windows.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Tầng hai mươi, nhìn ra cả thành phố, rồi cả căn phòng này lẫn ông chủ của nó sẽ là của mình.
clips.camera: 24mm wide shot, slow dolly through the glass office
beats: A bright glass-walled office high above the city, the large white desk gleaming in cold morning light with the skyline stretching beyond the windows.
@Vy walks in through the glass door in her crimson dress and beige high heels, mists a little perfume into the air by the desk and murmurs to herself with a slow smile.
@Vy closes her red lips and runs one fingertip along the back of the black leather chair, her winged eyes sweeping across the skyline.
clips.sfx: high heels clicking on a polished floor, a soft perfume spritz, air conditioning hum

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Vy à, em về làm thư ký mới ba tháng mà phòng anh lúc nào cũng thơm mùi nước hoa của em.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow push-in
beats: The white desk with a glossy black lacquered lunch box resting beside a framed family photo of Thu, Tùng and Na, the city skyline blurred in the windows behind.
@Tung strolls in through the glass door with his briefcase and finds @Vy standing by the desk, and he speaks to her with a slow pleased grin, breathing in the air.
@Tung closes his mouth and sinks into the black leather chair, while @Vy stands beside the desk turning her thin gold necklace between her fingers.
clips.sfx: a glass door sighing shut, footsteps on a polished floor, air conditioning hum

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh Tùng ơi, em tự tay nấu cơm trưa cho anh đấy, dạo này anh gầy đi nhiều quá.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot, slow push-in
beats: @Vy slides a glossy black lacquered lunch box across the white desk toward @Tung and begins to speak in a sweet soft voice.
@Vy keeps speaking as she leans one hand on the edge of the desk, tilting her head with a honeyed smile while @Tung looks up at her.
@Vy closes her mouth and waits with her head tilted, her red nails resting beside the lunch box, as @Tung reaches for the lid.
clips.sfx: a lunch box sliding on the desk, air conditioning hum

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Lâu lắm rồi mới có người lo cho anh một bữa trưa tử tế thế này đấy em ạ.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow rack focus between them
beats: @Tung lifts the lid of a glossy black lacquered lunch box and looks at the neat rows of food inside.
@Tung speaks to @Vy with a slow pleased grin, leaning back in the black leather chair.
@Vy lowers her eyes with a modest closed-mouth smile, her fingers trailing along the edge of the white desk.
clips.sfx: a lid lifting, chair leather creaking, faint traffic below

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Cơm nhà hàng dưới phố đấy, đàn ông chỉ cần nghe hai chữ tự tay là mềm lòng ngay.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow lateral dolly
beats: A slim waste bin beside the glass wall of the office, cold city light falling across the polished floor.
@Vy walks to the glass wall, drops a crumpled plain paper takeaway bag into the waste bin and murmurs under her breath with a mocking little smile, glancing back over her shoulder.
@Vy closes her red lips, brushes her palms together and smooths the front of her crimson dress, her eyes cold.
clips.sfx: paper crumpling, high heels on the floor, air conditioning hum

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Nhà ba người đẹp quá nhỉ, tiếc là tấm ảnh này sắp phải thay người đứng cạnh anh rồi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on the desk corner, slow push-in
beats: @Vy strolls back to the corner of the white desk, tilts her head toward a framed family photo of Thu, Tùng and Na and speaks to it in a sugary whisper.
@Vy keeps whispering with a sweet smile as she reaches out one manicured finger and slowly lays the frame face down on the desk.
@Vy closes her mouth, her red fingernails resting on the back of the face-down frame, her smile reflected cold in the glossy white surface.
clips.sfx: a soft tap of a frame on the desk, air conditioning hum

title: Người Tình Bí Mật
time_label: 12:00 Trưa, quán cà phê kín đáo (04:00–05:00)
location: Một quán cà phê sang trọng, kín đáo, cách tòa nhà văn phòng ba con phố.
axis: Bàn trong góc khuất bên phải màn hình sau chậu cau cảnh, cửa sổ cao nhìn ra phố cây xanh bên trái.
props: Ghế bành nhung, đèn đồng, bàn đá cẩm thạch, hai tách cà phê, kính râm và điện thoại của Vy, điện thoại và vòng tay bạc của Khải.
setting: An upscale café at noon: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, tall windows facing a leafy street.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh yêu ơi, em ra rồi đây, em bảo lão là đi gặp khách hàng, anh ngồi chỗ nào đấy?
clips.camera: 24mm wide establishing shot, slow pan across the room
beats: A hushed upscale café at noon, sunlight filtering through tall windows onto velvet armchairs and marble tables under warm brass lamps.
@Vy slips in through the café door in her crimson dress and dark sunglasses, a phone pressed to her ear, and speaks into it in a low honeyed voice while glancing around.
@Vy closes her mouth and keeps the phone to her ear, listening, her eyes searching toward a secluded corner half-hidden behind a tall potted palm.
clips.sfx: soft clinking of cups, a café door chime, muted street sounds

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Góc trong cùng, sau chậu cau ấy, em cứ đi thẳng vào, chỗ này kín đáo, chẳng ai nhìn thấy đâu.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in
beats: The secluded corner table behind the potted palm, two coffee cups on the marble and a velvet armchair angled toward the window.
@Khai leans back in the velvet armchair in his black slim-fit shirt with a phone at his ear, and speaks into it in a lazy low voice with a sly half-smile.
@Khai closes his mouth, sets the phone face down on the marble and lifts his coffee cup slightly toward the café entrance, his silver chain bracelet catching the lamplight.
clips.sfx: cups clinking, a low murmur, a café door chime

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Thế nào em, lão giám đốc cắn câu chưa? Hợp đồng lớn sắp ký rồi đấy.
clips.camera: 35mm over-the-shoulder two-shot, gentle dolly
beats: The corner table in warm lamplight, an empty velvet armchair facing the one by the window, a steaming cup set before it.
@Vy sinks into the empty armchair and slips off her sunglasses as @Khai leans toward her across the marble table and speaks in a low lazy voice.
@Khai taps one finger on the table with a sly grin, waiting, while @Vy folds her hands on her white handbag and studies him.
clips.sfx: cups clinking, a low café murmur

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Nửa năm thôi anh, em sẽ khiến lão bỏ vợ, sang tên hết nhà cửa cho em.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Vy stirs her coffee slowly, the spoon circling, her winged eyes lifting to meet @Khai's.
@Vy speaks to @Khai in a cool clipped voice, the sweetness gone from her face.
@Vy sets the spoon down on the saucer with a precise click and leans back, her red lips pressed into a thin line.
clips.sfx: a spoon clinking on porcelain, a low café murmur

clips.speaker: @Khai
clips.line: Đừng để lão biết có anh, đàn ông ngu đến mấy cũng có lúc tỉnh ra đấy em.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow lateral dolly
beats: @Khai rests his elbows on the marble table and lowers his head toward @Vy, his half-smile fading.
@Khai speaks quietly to @Vy, glancing once toward the café windows and the leafy street outside.
@Khai sits back and lifts his coffee cup in a small toast toward @Vy, his eyes sharp above the rim.
clips.sfx: a low café murmur, a car passing outside

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Anh yên tâm, lão mê em như điếu đổ, đến lúc lão tỉnh ra thì lão đã trắng tay rồi.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face over the coffee cup, slow push-in
beats: @Vy stirs her coffee in slow circles with a silver spoon and answers @Khai with a sweet smile, her red lips moving softly.
@Vy keeps speaking as the sweetness drains from her face, her winged eyes lifting cold and still above the cup.
@Vy closes her mouth and sets the spoon on the saucer with a precise click, while @Khai raises his cup to her at the soft edge of the frame.
clips.sfx: a spoon circling porcelain, a soft café murmur

title: Sợi Tóc Trên Áo Chồng
location: Gian bếp tầng trệt căn nhà ống lúc gần nửa đêm, chỉ một bóng đèn vàng và bếp than.
axis: Bàn ăn và ghế ở giữa, cầu thang dốc bên phải màn hình, bếp than bên trái.
props: Áo sơ mi trắng của Tùng có vệt son đỏ và sợi tóc nâu xoăn, cà vạt lụa, đôi giày đen, bếp than.
setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Thằng Tùng lại gần nửa đêm mới về, mùi rượu lẫn mùi nước hoa lạ nồng nặc cả nhà.
clips.camera: 35mm wide shot, slow dolly-in across the kitchen
beats: The dim kitchen at night lit by one warm bulb, the charcoal stove glowing low, a white dress shirt and a loosened silk tie draped carelessly over a dining chair.
@BaNhan comes slowly down the steep staircase leaning on her bamboo walking stick, stops beside the chair, sniffs the air and mutters to herself with her wrinkled face tight.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and stares at the rumpled white shirt hanging from the chair, a pair of polished black shoes left askew beneath it.
clips.sfx: the charcoal stove crackling softly, a dog barking far away, a door closing upstairs

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Khuya rồi con còn xuống làm gì, áo của nó cứ để đấy, đêm nào con cũng phải giặt cho nó à?
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow push-in
beats: The wooden dining chair under the warm bulb, the white shirt and loose tie draped over its back, the charcoal stove glowing beside it.
@Thu comes down the last stairs in her faded blouse and picks up the white shirt from the chair, as @BaNhan, leaning on her stick by the table, speaks to her in a low tired voice.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and shakes her head slowly, while @Thu folds the shirt over her arm and lifts the collar toward the light, her brows drawing together.
clips.sfx: soft footsteps, fabric rustling, the stove crackling

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mẹ ơi, son đỏ trên cổ áo, còn sợi tóc xoăn màu nâu này, đâu phải tóc của con.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up on her face above the collar, slow rack focus
beats: @Thu turns the white collar toward the bulb beside her face, revealing a smudge of bright red lipstick on the fabric, and starts to speak to @BaNhan in a trembling whisper.
@Thu keeps speaking as she lifts a single long wavy brown hair from the shoulder of the shirt and holds it up in the warm light beside her face.
@Thu closes her mouth, her eyes wide and wet above the shirt, while @BaNhan's wrinkled hand tightens on her bamboo stick at the edge of the frame.
clips.sfx: a sharp intake of breath, the stove crackling, silence

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh Tùng, vệt son trên áo anh là của ai? Anh nói thật với em đi.
clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot from the kitchen doorway, slow dolly
beats: The foot of the steep staircase in the dim warm light, the dining table between the stairs and the glowing stove.
@Tung appears on the lower stairs loosening his collar, and @Thu holds up the white shirt toward him from across the table and speaks in a trembling but steady voice.
@Thu keeps the shirt raised between them, her knuckles pale, while @Tung stops two steps above the floor.
clips.sfx: the stove crackling, a creaking stair

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Tiếp khách thì dính son là chuyện thường, cô đừng nghĩ linh tinh rồi làm ầm lên.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Tung rolls his eyes and waves one hand dismissively, stepping down onto the tiled floor.
@Tung speaks flatly to @Thu without looking at the shirt, his jaw set and his eyelids heavy with drink.
@Tung turns his back on @Thu and climbs the stairs again, one hand on the rail, leaving her below.
clips.sfx: heavy footsteps on the stairs, the stove crackling

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Bao nhiêu năm vợ chồng, đến một câu nói thật anh ấy cũng chẳng cho mình nữa rồi.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from the kitchen, slow push-in
beats: The bottom of the steep tiled staircase in the dim kitchen, the bulb's warm light fading and the charcoal stove reduced to faint embers.
@Thu sits down on the lowest stair with the white shirt clutched in both hands in her lap and whispers to herself, her lips trembling, her back against the wall.
@Thu closes her mouth and sits motionless on the step as pale blue dawn light slowly creeps under the front door, the shirt still crushed in her hands.
clips.sfx: embers ticking, a distant rooster at dawn, silence

title: Chuyến Công Tác Đà Nẵng
time_label: Chiều tà, khu nghỉ dưỡng biển (06:00–07:00)
location: Hồ bơi vô cực của một khu nghỉ dưỡng sang trọng ven biển lúc hoàng hôn; clip 5–6 ở bếp nhà Thu ban đêm.
axis: Hai ghế dài trắng bên mép hồ bơi, biển phía sau bên trái màn hình; ở nhà Thu, bàn ăn ở giữa, ghế trống của Tùng bên phải.
props: Ghế dài trắng, hai ly nước cam, điện thoại của Tùng, chiếc bánh sinh nhật nhỏ có một ngọn nến, ghế trống của Tùng.
setting: Sunset at a luxury seaside resort: an infinity pool terrace with white loungers, palm trees, the sea glowing orange.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Anh còn kẹt công tác ở Đà Nẵng, sinh nhật em anh không về kịp, em với con cứ ăn trước đi.
clips.camera: 24mm aerial slow descending orbit down to the pool terrace
beats: High aerial view of a luxury seaside resort at sunset, palm trees swaying above a long curve of golden beach and a calm orange sea.
The camera sweeps down to the infinity pool terrace, where @Tung, his suit jacket off, stands by a white lounger with a phone at his ear and speaks into it in a flat dutiful voice.
@Tung closes his mouth, lowers the phone and tosses it onto the lounger with a smirk, the pool's edge blending into the shining sea behind him.
clips.sfx: gentle waves, palm fronds rustling, distant seabirds

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Công tác gì mà chỉ có hai đứa mình, bên bể bơi nhìn ra biển thế này hả anh?
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow lateral dolly along the pool
beats: Two white loungers at the edge of the infinity pool, a small table between them holding two glasses of orange juice, the sea glowing beyond.
@Vy in her crimson dress sits on one lounger and hands @Tung a glass of orange juice as he settles beside her, and she teases him in a sweet mocking voice.
@Vy closes her mouth and clinks her glass against @Tung's, the two of them sitting close and gazing out at the orange sea.
clips.sfx: gentle waves, glasses clinking, a soft breeze

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Ở bên anh em mới biết thế nào là được yêu, vợ anh có biết chiều anh thế này không?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Vy turns toward @Tung on the lounger, resting her chin on her hand, the sunset gilding her wavy hair.
@Vy speaks to @Tung in a sweet coaxing voice, her winged eyes half-lowered.
@Vy tilts her head and waits with a soft closed-mouth smile, turning the glass slowly between her fingers.
clips.sfx: waves lapping, a soft breeze

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Cô ấy chỉ biết xôi với chợ thôi em ạ, sống với cô ấy anh thấy mình già đi mười tuổi.
clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow pull-back
beats: @Tung sets his glass down on the small table and leans back on the lounger with a long sigh.
@Tung speaks to @Vy with a dismissive shrug, his eyes on the darkening sea.
@Vy lays her hand lightly over @Tung's on the armrest as the last sunlight fades behind them.
clips.sfx: waves, a breeze through the palms

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Bố bận công tác rồi, sinh nhật mẹ con ước giúp mẹ một điều đi, rồi mình thổi nến.
clips.camera: 40mm over-the-shoulder shot across the birthday cake, slow push-in
beats: The wooden dining table in the dim kitchen at night, a small round birthday cake with a single unlit candle, three bowls and one empty chair.
@Na carefully lights the single candle with a match while @Thu, facing the camera across the cake, speaks to her softly with a thin brave smile, both faces lit by the tiny flame.
@Thu closes her mouth and rests her hand on @Na's shoulder as both glance at the empty chair across the table, the candle flickering between them.
clips.sfx: a match striking, a faint candle hiss, rain beginning outside
clips.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Mẹ ơi, con ước bố về ăn cơm với mẹ con mình, như hồi nhà mình còn nghèo ấy.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Na clasps her small hands together in front of the candle and closes her eyes for a moment.
@Na opens her eyes and speaks softly to @Thu, her face glowing in the candlelight.
@Thu presses her lips together and strokes @Na's hair, her eyes glistening as the candle flame trembles.
clips.sfx: a candle flickering, soft rain on the roof
clips.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

title: Bức Ảnh Lúc Nửa Đêm
location: Gian bếp tầng trệt căn nhà ống lúc nửa đêm; clip cuối ở chiếu nghỉ cầu thang.
axis: Bàn ăn ở giữa, bếp bên trái, cầu thang bên phải màn hình dẫn lên chiếu nghỉ.
props: Điện thoại của Tùng (màn hình chỉ phát sáng, không chữ), chìa khóa xe, bàn ăn gỗ, gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh Tuấn kế toán à? Nửa đêm rồi, kế toán gì mà gọi cho anh ấy vào giờ này?
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in on the table
beats: The dining table in the dim kitchen, a sleek black smartphone lying face-up beside a car key, the bulb casting a warm circle of light.
The phone buzzes with a blank white glow as @Thu steps over from the stove, looks down at it and murmurs to herself, her brows knitting, her face lit from below.
@Thu closes her mouth and hesitates with her damp hand hovering above the glowing phone, glancing once toward the dark staircase.
clips.sfx: a phone buzzing on wood, a dripping tap

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Trời ơi, cô gái váy đỏ này đang tựa vào vai chồng mình, anh Tuấn kế toán là thế này đây à?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in on her face
beats: @Thu picks up the phone and its screen casts a cold white glow up across her face, her eyes fixing on it as her lips start to move in a broken whisper.
@Thu keeps whispering with her pupils trembling and her voice catching, the phone shaking slightly in her hand.
@Thu closes her mouth and slowly presses her free hand over it, a single tear sliding down her cheek in the cold light.
clips.sfx: the tap dripping, a heavy silence

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Cô lục điện thoại của tôi à? Cô còn biết tôn trọng chồng mình không hả?
clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot from the stove, slow dolly
beats: The steep staircase and the dining table in the dim kitchen, the phone's cold glow the brightest light in the room.
@Tung strides down the last stairs and stops on the far side of the table from @Thu, pointing at the phone in her hand as he speaks sharply.
@Tung holds out his open palm across the table, waiting, while @Thu stays where she is with the phone held against her chest.
clips.sfx: heavy footsteps on tiles, the tap dripping

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Mười hai năm em bán cả bông tai cưới cho anh làm ăn, anh trả em thế này sao?
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Thu sets the glowing phone face-down on the table between them, her hand trembling as she lets go.
@Thu speaks to @Tung with her chin lifted and her voice cracking, tears standing in her eyes.
@Thu keeps her gaze locked on @Tung, breathing hard, her fingers gripping the edge of the table.
clips.sfx: a phone set down on wood, the tap dripping

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Chuyện cũ rồi, đừng lôi ra kể công mãi, tôi chán cái nhà này lắm rồi.
clips.camera: 50mm over-the-shoulder shot, slow dolly
beats: @Tung picks his phone up off the table and slips it into his trouser pocket without looking at @Thu.
@Tung speaks coldly to @Thu with a flick of his hand toward the room around them, his mouth twisted.
@Tung turns away and climbs the stairs two at a time, leaving @Thu alone at the table under the swaying bulb.
clips.sfx: footsteps on the stairs, a door shutting hard upstairs

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Tôi nghe hết rồi, thằng con tôi dứt ruột đẻ ra mà nỡ nói với vợ nó những lời như thế.
clips.camera: 50mm medium low-angle shot up the stairwell, slow push-in
beats: A dim tiled stair landing in darkness, a faint warm glow rising from the kitchen below and a closed door above.
@BaNhan stands pressed against the wall of the landing in her brown cardigan, both hands clenched on her bamboo walking stick, and whispers to herself with trembling lips.
@BaNhan closes her mouth, lowers her head and shuts her eyes, her thin shoulders shaking as the light from below flickers across her wrinkled face.
clips.sfx: a door closing upstairs, the faint drip of a tap below, silence
clips.setting: Night on the dim tiled stair landing of the tube house, a faint light from the kitchen below.
